Object / Material / Homepage / Smart Chen

A contact card designed as a physical object: aluminum, perlage finishing, engraved lettering, and a single moving studio light to reveal its surface.

Design perspective

Identity is carried by material as well as information. The CMF choices draw inspiration from the titanium Apple Card and traditional watchmaking techniques. Cursor movement and device tilt change the card's orientation relative to a simulated light source, revealing the perlage finish through shifting reflections.

Recorded development

Motion / Transition / Homepage + Projects → The Gallery

A wireframe animation takes viewers through a viewfinder into an imagined museum, revealing the gallery.

Design perspective

Entering a collection becomes a spatial journey. The viewfinder, architecture, and destination are connected through one continuous movement.

Motion / Film / Homepage / car enthusiast

A wireframe animation of a MINI Cooper and a BMW Z4 chasing each other through a narrow street in Paris.

Design perspective

I bought the MINI Cooper S F55 after my BMW Z4 E85 was totaled in an accident. The two cars had never shared the same frame until this animation.

Interface / Playground / 404 / Unavailable pages

The 404 page becomes a construction site where objects can be added, moved, and rotated.

Design perspective

Inspired by a photo I took in a bathroom at Emory University's Cox Hall. The bathroom looked almost exactly like this, so I recreated it as an interactive construction site.

Object / Cursor / Polaroid of Yesterday / Game Design Document

A folding SX-70 replaces the document cursor. It opens, enters a viewfinder, photographs the page, and ejects a print.

Design perspective

Inspired by my game Polaroid of Yesterday, in which the protagonist uses an SX-70 camera. The interaction brings an element of the game's world into the website.

Recorded development

  1. 2026.09.22The Polaroid cursor is introduced.Record
  2. 2026.09.22The camera model and interaction details are refined.Record

Interactive edition preserved 2026.10.27. Earlier development records are linked above.

Object / Interaction / Homepage + Shared website pointer

One pointer changes shape to express what can happen next.

Design perspective

Inspired by the iPadOS cursor, the design uses shape and motion to communicate how users can interact with different elements before clicking.
